newsitem.title: QATAR: European Union gas import dependency to grow.
newsitem.headline: European Union gas import dependency to grow.

text.p: The European Union's dependence on imported natural gas will rise to 75 percent beyond 2010 from 40 percent now, a document prepared by the European Commission said on Sunday.

"All EC member states (will) face a shortfall to a greater or lesser extent in contracted supplies and for the EC as a whole," according to a document circulated at a two-day natural gas conference which opened in the Qatari capital on Sunday.
"Declining indigenous production combined with an expected large increase in demand may lead to an EC import dependence of up to 75 percent after the year 2010 to 2020," the study said.

EU gas consumption amounts to 255 million tonnes of oil equivalent (mtoe), of which around 100 mtoe is imported mainly from Russia, Algeria and Norway, and 157 mtoe is produced indigenously, mainly by the Netherlands and the UK (55 mtoe each).
The document said gas demand in the EU is estimated to rise by 22-26 percent to 311-320 mtoe by 2000.
"Gas will represent around 22 percent of the EC's total primary energy consumption...By this time EU external dependency may have risen to nearly 60 percent."
Gas currently has a 20 percent share of the European energy market.
